rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a firmly held personal belief or conviction, including a faith that sustains someone.

example.english: This belief keeps me going even when I face major setbacks.
example.traditional: 呢個信念令我就算遇到幾大挫折都繼續行落去。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seon3 nim6 ling6 ngo5 zau6 syun3 jyu6 dou3 gei2 daai6 co3 zit3 dou1 gai3 zuk6 haang4 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when belief means someone's view or opinion about whether a claim is true, rather than a firm conviction.

example.english: My belief about this matter is different from yours.
example.traditional: 我對呢件事嘅睇法同你唔同。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 tung4 nei5 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use this specifically for religious faith or a religion someone follows.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zyun1 zung6 mui5 go3 jan4 ge3 seon3 joeng5
